decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template is aging and may be outdated by 2022, but it costs little to keep and still supports the firm's shop-hosting customers.
The responsive template is cheap to maintain and helps agencies start projects on the platform, though it may quietly lose relevance.
The version management tool fits the firm's strategy of tools that cut developers' recurring work and is likely built into the platform.
Demand for GDPR data processing contracts persists and the tool is cheap to run, even though it is far from the core business.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and the core of its strategic direction.
